content: RAI ships a 'Hello RAI' demo using a Streamlit chat interface for text HRI, and a CLI/ros2-topic-pub alternative (publish rai_interfaces/msg/HRIMessage to /from_human, echo /to_human) for headless interaction, as shown in the walkthrough tutorial. ROS2HRIConnector is the connector type that bridges these text messages onto ROS2 topics; target_connectors lets an agent fan its response out to multiple sinks (e.g. Streamlit UI + logging) at once. Source: robotecai.github.io/rai/tutorials/walkthrough/, deepwiki.com/RobotecAI/rai/3-agent-system.
